name: The Seasons Changing
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs the changing seasons and times, establishing a divinely ordained order that will not cease while the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). The appointed times, marked by the sun and moon, reflect His wisdom and purpose in all things (Psalms 104:19; Daniel 2:21). Believers are assured that God’s timing is perfect, making everything beautiful in its season and providing a time for every purpose under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1,11). Like a tree flourishing in its appointed season, those who trust in God will prosper according to His divine timetable (Psalms 1:3).
